What we eliminated in whey protein isolate

145 of the 176 products we analysed never reached a score. Each one broke a rule that points at a regulator, a trial or a published re-evaluation — and each row below says which.

Some of these are excellent brands. Being on this page is not an accusation of bad faith; it means one ingredient in one formulation did not survive a doctrine that refuses to make exceptions.
